QSR Daily Ops Monitor v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces structured daily compliance monitoring for restaurant and franchise operations.
- Runs three scheduled check-ins per day (opening, mid-shift, closing) with five core items each.
- Tracks patterns in responses, late/missed checks, and compliance issues over time.
- Includes first-run setup with essential configuration questions for tailored operation.
- Designed for ease-of-use with concise prompts and minimal disruption to daily workflow.
- Compatible with pattern tracking and summary features on advanced models.
